sql:
SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  boat,
  cls,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 26
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 50
